description: Plays positional sound with given ''filename'' on every computer on network. To stop the sound use [[stopSound]]
examples: <sqf>playSound3D [getMissionPath "mySound.ogg", player]; // to play a mission directory sound</sqf>

Sound file extension must be specified even if a config entry has none:
<sqf>
playSound3D ["A3\Sounds_F\sfx\alarm_independent", player];		// no sound
playSound3D ["A3\Sounds_F\sfx\alarm_independent.wss", player];	// alarm
</sqf>
name: playSound3D

Item.desc: see [[Arma 3: Sound Files]] for available file names or {{Link|#Example 3}} to use mission files
Item.name: filename

Item.desc: the object emitting the sound. If ''soundPosition'' below is specified this parameter is ignored
Item.name: soundSource

Item.desc: - [[true]] to simulate a sound played inside a building or similar
Item.name: isInside

Item.desc: position for sound emitter, overrides ''soundSource''. [[Object]] is also supported (see note below).
Item.name: soundPosition

Item.desc: sound volume. A value greater than 5 gets capped
Item.name: volume

Item.desc: how far the sound is audible, in meters. {{hl|0}} means no maximum distance
Item.name: distance

Item.desc: offset in seconds. Same as with [[playMusic]] (ignored if sound is set to play repeatedly, see 'loop')
Item.name: offset

Item.desc: if [[true]] the sound will not be broadcast over network
Item.name: local

Item.desc: if [[true]] the sound will repeat indefinitely. In MP, requires 'local' to be set to [[true]]. Use [[stopSound]] to stop.
Item.name: loop
